label: PF Backlog 673
title: Structured outbox metrics and alerting for event authority
body: BI-PF-1268 left outbox-bound backpressure with log-only observability. Add structured metrics for pending/claimed outbox rows, bound rejections, prune counts and projection failures so operators can alert across instances without parsing stderr.

acceptance_criteria: Expose an outbox_rows_current gauge by tenant/status and an EVENT_OUTBOX_BOUND_EXCEEDED counter, with owner and alert threshold documented and tested.
Emit structured outbox prune and projection-failure signals through the existing observability owner, not ad-hoc stderr logging, and verify them in tests.
